_about: Import boundary rules for architecture:check. Layers: server, src, test, script, appBuilder, other. Edges not listed are denied unless allowedExceptions match.

allowedExceptions.reason: Shared APP_VERSION and product constants; listed in tsconfig.server.json include
Shared numeric validation used by server routes; listed in tsconfig.server.json include
Support contacts / distress markers; listed in tsconfig.server.json include
Single source of truth for APP_VERSION and APP_PATCH per AGENTS.md; Vite plugin injects only these fields into the client bundle

notes: src must not import server (client bundle isolation).
server may only reach src via the three exceptions above until a dedicated shared/ package exists.
appBuilder must not import server or src; adapters live in server/ and inject ports.
New cross-layer edges require an allowedExceptions entry or a rule change approved by the Navigator.
